activity.notes: Aung San served as Minister of War in the Japanese-backed State of Burma proclaimed on 1 August 1943 under Ba Maw. He was not the head of state: Ba Maw held that position. Aung San increasingly regarded the Japanese-sponsored independence as a sham and became a principal organizer of the anti-fascist resistance; on 27 March 1945 the Burma National Army turned against Japan. ATLAS therefore records Aung San as a minister serving the State of Burma rather than falsely treating the custom-civilization leader slot as national rulership.
